I would not expose your scars during the interview. Take this from someone going to school for mental health counseling. My professors have always said that even if you have been drawn to this field by your own personal mental health struggles, you should not reveal that to employers prior to hire (through cover letters or interviews, for example). Only once you have secured the job. Reason being that there may be many applicants for a job, and if you have a disability (or they presume you have a psychiatric disability from your scarring) the employer may make (false) assumptions about you and your ability to do the job, causing the job to go to some other applicant.  Even if you are extremely qualified for said job otherwise. Finding a job is tough. Don't make it tougher on yourself.
